visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit indoor room, a young boy with glasses and a red-and-white shirt cries while holding a pen over a workbook. A woman with long hair and a white tank top stands over him with an angry facial expression, pointing at the desk. (2) Dramatic visual effects of flames and variety-show text appear. The woman and the boy are shown in a montage of shouting and exaggerated facial movements, mimicking a rap battle or intense argument. (3) The scene shifts to a bright, well-lit indoor space. The woman holds two large gift boxes of cooking oil, smiling joyfully with wide eyes and a beaming expression. (4) A man wearing a white 'Anonymous' mask appears in the frame, taking the gift boxes from the woman. The background is a clean, modern apartment interior. (5) Close-up shots of hands pouring golden oil from a 'Great Day' brand bottle into a pan with shrimp and pasta. A smartphone screen is briefly shown displaying a ChatGPT interface. (6) Detailed product shots of various 'Great Day' oil bottles (Olive, Avocado, Rice Bran) appear against a light green background. Hands are shown using a specialized green pourer attachment on a bottle. (7) The woman is shown eating a salad with a fork, looking satisfied. Finally, she and the masked man sit together at a table, eating the prepared pasta and giving a double thumbs-up to the camera.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The woman wears a white and black sleeveless top and has long brown hair. The boy wears a red and white t-shirt and glasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The background transitions from a slightly dark study area with a wooden desk to a bright, modern living/dining area with white walls and track lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal screaming and crying from a child voice, followed immediately by aggressive, fast-paced female shouting. A rhythmic electronic beat starts with high percussive density. (2) The female voice transitions into a rapid-fire, rap-like delivery over a steady 4/4 EDM beat. Short 'whoosh' and 'impact' sound effects are peppered between phrases. (3) A digital transition sound effect triggers a shift in mood. The music becomes bright and uplifting pop. A female voice speaks with very high arousal and positive valence, sounding extremely enthusiastic. (4) A professional male voice with clear articulation and moderate pitch enters the mix, narrating product features over the upbeat BGM. (5) Periodic sound effects of oil sizzling and metallic clinks of pans provide acoustic texture under the narration. (6) The video concludes with a group vocalization of the brand slogan, delivered with high energy and a rising intonation pattern.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Stressful Skit -> Solution Reveal -> Product Demonstration -> Positive Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable and humorous parenting struggle (homework stress) to grab attention before pivoting into an advertisement for 'Great Day' brand cooking oils. It suggests that while parenting is hard, choosing healthy oils for the family is a way to bring 'great days' and health to the home.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features direct product presentation, close-up shots of brand logos, and a professional narration of product health benefits.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video's successful use of the 'bait-and-switch' comedy format likely targets mothers and families. The high technical quality of the audio and visual editing suggests a professional marketing campaign.
